lines.en: label ramen20:
scene blackout1
I decide to drop by the ramen shop to check on Tsuneyo and grab a quick bite to eat.
lines.zh: 我决定顺路去拉面店看看 Tsuneyo，顺便快速吃点东西。

lines.en: But judging by the way she’s staring at me, I think it’s safe to assume that she is not very happy with my decision to do this.
lines.zh: 但看她盯着我的样子，我觉得可以肯定，她对我这个决定不太满意。

lines.en: I want to say she's only looking at me like this because I ordered a plate of curry instead of ramen tonight, but the scowl has been there since before I even ordered.
lines.zh: 我想说她这么看我只是因为今晚我点了一份咖喱而不是拉面，可那副臭脸在我点单之前就已经在那儿了。

lines.en: : Did I do something to offend you?
lines.zh: : 我做了什么冒犯你的事吗？

lines.en: : Is this about driving customers away again?
lines.zh: : 又是因为我把客人赶跑了吗？

lines.en: : I followed your advice and asked the Emerald Guardian to remind me of what sex is.
lines.zh: : 我听了你的建议，请翡翠守护者提醒我性是什么。

lines.en: : Why did you allow me to say so many things about fucking?
lines.zh: : 你为什么任由我说出那么多关于做爱的话？

lines.en: : Now everyone thinks I am a harlot.
lines.zh: : 现在所有人都觉得我是个荡妇了。

lines.en: : Not everyone. Just Uta and Yumi’s mom.
lines.zh: : 不是所有人。只有 Uta 和 Yumi 的妈妈。

lines.en: : Word gets around about girls like me. It won’t be long before the whole class knows.
lines.zh: : 像我这样的女孩，传言传得可快了。用不了多久全班都会知道。

lines.en: : Also, those aren’t noodles in front of you.
lines.zh: : 还有，你面前那不是面条。

lines.en: : Why are you doing this to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这样对我？

lines.en: Ahh, so I guess the curry was part of it after all.
lines.zh: 啊，看来咖喱果然也是原因之一。

lines.en: : On the bright side, it looks like you were able to learn more about modern dialogue. So all was not lost, right?
lines.zh: : 往好处想，你总算学到了不少现代对白。所以也不算全无收获，对吧？

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 操你的。

lines.en: : Not literally, though. I understand what that would mean now.
lines.zh: : 不过不是字面意思。我现在明白那是什么意思了。

lines.en: : It sounds very painful.
lines.zh: : 听起来很痛。

lines.en: : And you’re not completely opposed to using that word even though you understand it now?
lines.zh: : 既然你现在懂了，却还是不排斥用那个词？

lines.en: : Color me impressed.
lines.zh: : 真让我刮目相看。

lines.en: : I hope you choke on your non-noodle food and die.
lines.zh: : 我希望你被那盘不是面条的食物噎死。

lines.en: : Why even sell it if you don’t approve of it as a product?
lines.zh: : 既然你不认可这个产品，为什么还要卖它？

lines.en: : My father has informed me that it must remain on the menu for as long as he is alive.
lines.zh: : 我父亲告诉过我，只要他还活着，它就必须留在菜单上。

lines.en: : And with his days among us numbered, the days of this curry’s existence are numbered as well.
lines.zh: : 而他在我们身边的日子已经屈指可数，这咖喱存在的日子也屈指可数了。

lines.en: : The time for reckoning is upon us.
lines.zh: : 清算的时刻已经降临。

lines.en: : You’re sounding more and more like Molly every day.
lines.zh: : 你一天比一天更像 Molly 了。

lines.en: scene blackout2
: That is worrying to hear.
lines.zh: : 这话听着让人担忧。

lines.en: : With the things the other girls say about her, I’m beginning to believe the Emerald Guardian is not as omniscient as I initially thought she was.
lines.zh: : 听了其他女孩对她的评价，我开始觉得翡翠守护者并不像我最初以为的那样无所不知。

lines.en: : She is but another fruit that has fallen off the tree of life, and I am the lowly earthworm feeding off of her decaying corpse.
lines.zh: : 她不过是又一颗从生命之树上掉落的果实，而我是一条以她腐烂的尸体为食的卑微蚯蚓。

lines.en: : Now you’re sounding less like Molly and more like a serial killer.
lines.zh: : 现在你听起来不像 Molly，倒更像连环杀手了。

lines.en: scene blackout3
: Well {i}you’re{/i} sounding like a little bitch.
lines.zh: : 哼，{i}你{/i}听起来才像个小婊子。

lines.en: scene blackout4
: I apologize if I didn’t use that word correctly.
lines.zh: : 如果那个词我用得不对，我道歉。

lines.en: : I heard the delinquent girl with mother issues call you that and you seem to fear her.
lines.zh: : 我听到那个有母亲问题的不良少女这么叫你，而你似乎很怕她。

lines.en: : First off, that was harsh.
lines.zh: : 首先，这话太狠了。

lines.en: : Yumi’s issues with her mom are a private matter that only those two and sometimes myself are allowed to get involved in.
lines.zh: : Yumi 和她母亲之间的问题属于私事，只有她们俩、有时再加上我才能介入。

lines.en: : Secondly, I am not {i}afraid{/i} of Yumi.
lines.zh: : 其次，我并不「{i}怕{/i}」Yumi。

lines.en: : But she defeated the Green Onion in a battle of arm strength so easily.
lines.zh: : 可她那么轻易就在掰手腕里击败了青葱。

lines.en: : What if you are next?
lines.zh: : 万一下一个是你呢？

lines.en: : I'm curious to know about what chain of events would possibly lead to that.
lines.zh: : 我很好奇，究竟要发生怎样的一连串事件才会导致那种结果。

lines.en: : I’m really not afraid of Yumi, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的不怕 Yumi。

lines.en: : But I sense fear when you two are in close proximity to one another.
lines.zh: : 可你们两个靠近的时候，我能感觉到恐惧。

lines.en: : Is it possible that you are the one {i}she{/i} fears instead?
lines.zh: : 会不会其实是{i}她{/i}在怕你？

lines.en: scene yumi10
scene blackout4
: I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我不这么认为。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she’s almost finished getting over the one thing I’ve done that {i}would{/i} scare her.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，我做过唯一{i}会{/i}吓到她的那件事，她也差不多已经放下了。

lines.en: : What did you do?
lines.zh: : 你做了什么？

lines.en: : That’s not really any of your concern.
lines.zh: : 这跟你没什么关系。

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 没关系吗？

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : I think you may be misunderstanding the purpose of this restaurant, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能误解了这家店的意义，Sensei。

lines.en: : Are noodles...not the purpose of this restaurant?
lines.zh: : 面条……不是这家店的意义吗？

lines.en: : They are the first purpose.
lines.zh: : 那是第一重意义。

lines.en: : But this store is much more than just noodles to myself and many others.
lines.zh: : 但对我和许多其他人来说，这家店远不止是面条。

lines.en: scene blackout5
: Tojo Ramen is a special restaurant where people from all walks of life can gather to consume pork broth and air out their worries.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 是一家特别的店，各行各业的人都能聚在这里喝着猪骨汤，把烦恼一吐为快。

lines.en: : It is a place where people are free to speak their minds without worrying about persecution from others.
lines.zh: : 在这里，人们可以自由地说出心里话，不必担心被别人追责。

lines.en: : A calm, quiet sanctuary in an otherwise dead section of the world.
lines.zh: : 在这片死气沉沉的世界角落里，它是一处平静的避难所。

lines.en: : So, if there are things you wish to confess, there is no better place to do so than here.
lines.zh: : 所以，如果你有心事想倾诉，没有比这儿更好的地方了。

lines.en: scene blackout6
: Anything you say or do at this counter will never leave the restaurant so long as you do not want it to.
lines.zh: : 只要你自己不愿意，你在这柜台前说的任何话、做的任何事，都不会传出这家店。

lines.en: : Such is the promise of Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 这就是 Tojo Ramen 的承诺。

lines.en: : It’s starting to make a little more sense why this has become a hangout spot for the Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 我渐渐明白这里为什么会变成山口组的聚集地了。

lines.en: : Also, you should smile more. You look really cute right now.
lines.zh: : 还有，你该多笑笑。你现在看起来真的很可爱。

lines.en: scene blackout7
: It’s not me, it’s the noodles.
lines.zh: : 不是我，是面条。

lines.en: : No, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 不，是你。

lines.en: : Noodles.
lines.zh: : 面条。

lines.en: I guess it makes sense that this place could also serve as a haven of sorts for some people.
lines.zh: 我想，这地方对某些人来说能成为某种避风港，也说得通。

lines.en: Late night restaurants with swarms of locals and nostalgic atmospheres are not exactly a foreign concept.
lines.zh: 深夜餐馆、成群的本地客、怀旧的氛围，并不是什么陌生的概念。

lines.en: In fact, there’s probably a Tojo Ramen in every city in the world.
lines.zh: 事实上，世界上每座城市大概都有一家 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: Now, on the other hand, I highly doubt there is a Tsuneyo Tojo in every city in the world.
lines.zh: 可另一方面，我严重怀疑不是每座城市都有一个 Tsuneyo Tojo。

lines.en: She’s certainly proven to be...one of a kind so far.
lines.zh: 到目前为止，她确实证明了自己是……独一无二的。

lines.en: But when you grow up in a place like this, breaking the necks of fowls and listening to tattooed men confess crimes between 300 Yen beer refills-
lines.zh: 但当你在这样的地方长大——拧断鸡的脖子、听着纹身大汉在续杯三百日元啤酒的间隙坦白罪行——

lines.en: I guess there’s not much of a chance to ever learn how the real world works.
lines.zh: 我想你大概没什么机会了解真实世界的运作方式。

lines.en: scene blackout8
: How was the speech?
lines.zh: : 刚才那番话怎么样？

lines.en: : I memorized word-for-word what my father would say when he was still well enough to converse with others.
lines.zh: : 我把父亲还能跟人交谈时常说的话，一字不差地背了下来。

lines.en: : He can’t even talk?
lines.zh: : 他连话都说不了了？

lines.en: : He can make noise, but the only one who understands him is me.
lines.zh: : 他能发出声音，但只有我听得懂。

lines.en: : Is it okay for me to ask what’s wrong with him, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我能问问他到底得了什么病吗？

lines.en: : It is not.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : You shouldn't worry about that.
lines.zh: : 你不用担心这个。

lines.en: : All you have to do is enjoy your noodle-less dinner and speak what’s on your mind.
lines.zh: : 你只要好好享用你这顿没有面的晚餐，把心里话说出来就行。

lines.en: : Easier said than done.
lines.zh: : 说起来容易做起来难。

lines.en: : Japanese men aren’t exactly known for being open and honest about their feelings- and I’m pretty sure I talk even less than most of them.
lines.zh: : 日本男人本就不以坦率表达感情著称——而我敢肯定我比他们大多数人说得还少。

lines.en: : My father is the same way.
lines.zh: : 我父亲也是这样。

lines.en: : Or {i}was{/i} the same way.
lines.zh: : 或者说，{i}曾经{/i}是这样。

lines.en: : He doesn’t say much of anything anymore. But he does not need to.
lines.zh: : 他现在几乎什么都不说了。但他也不需要说。

lines.en: : All he needs to do is recover.
lines.zh: : 他只需要好起来。

lines.en: : And hopefully live forever so I can continue to avoid perpetual sadness like I have done for the rest of my incredibly boring life.
lines.zh: : 但愿他能永远活着，好让我能像这无聊透顶的一生里所做的那样，继续回避那永恒的悲伤。

lines.en: : Here’s to avoiding perpetual sadness, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那就为了回避永恒的悲伤干杯吧，大概。

lines.en: : A strange toast, but one that I enjoy.
lines.zh: : 这祝酒词真怪，不过我喜欢。

lines.en: : I would drink to it if alcohol did not make me fall asleep the second it comes into contact with my tongue.
lines.zh: : 要不是酒精一碰到我的舌头就会让我睡着，我早就举杯了。

lines.en: I reach for the spoon and finally take a bite of the curry Tsuneyo laid out in front of me some time ago.
lines.zh: 我伸手拿起勺子，终于尝了一口 Tsuneyo 早就摆在我面前的咖喱。

lines.en: It’s good, but it doesn’t measure up to the quality I’ve gotten used to from the ramen.
lines.zh: 挺好吃的，但比不上我已经习惯的拉面的水准。

lines.en: I guess Tsuneyo just doesn’t put the same level of care into this dish as she does the others.
lines.zh: 我想 Tsuneyo 只是没在这道菜上投入和其他菜一样的心思。

lines.en: scene blackout9
: Do you regret your decision now?
lines.zh: : 你现在后悔自己的决定了吗？

lines.en: : You mean do I regret ordering curry?
lines.zh: : 你是说后悔点咖喱？

lines.en: : Yes. You have a face that says “It’s good, but doesn’t measure up to the quality of the ramen.”
lines.zh: : 是的。你那张脸写着「挺好吃，但比不上拉面的水准」。

lines.en: : That’s...exactly what I was thinking. But I don’t regret my decision.
lines.zh: : 这……正是我刚才想的。但我不后悔。

lines.en: : If I wanted ramen, I would have ordered ramen.
lines.zh: : 我想要拉面的话，就点拉面了。

lines.en: : Not everyone wants ramen every night, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人每晚都想吃拉面的，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene blackout1
: When I told you it was okay to confess horrible things here, I did not mean {i}that{/i} horrible.
lines.zh: : 我说在这儿坦白可怕的事没关系，可没让你坦白「{i}那么{/i}」可怕的事。

lines.en: : I’m still interested in hearing why the delinquent girl is afraid of you.
lines.zh: : 我还是很想知道，那个不良少女为什么怕你。

lines.en: : Listen, I’m glad that this place is the sort of restaurant where I can {i}air out my worries{/i} but...that’s not the type of person I am.
lines.zh: : 听着，我很高兴这地方是那种能让我「{i}一吐烦恼{/i}」的餐馆，可是……我不是那种人。

lines.en: scene blackout10
: And I am not the type of person who is accustomed to looking death in the eye, yet I have been doing just that since our discussion in my room.
lines.zh: : 我也不是那种习惯直视死亡的人，可从我们在我房间那次谈话之后，我就一直在直视它。

lines.en: : Growing up means leaving your comfort zone.
lines.zh: : 长大意味着走出舒适区。

lines.en: : It is why I come to[school] and why I learn.
lines.zh: : 这就是我来[school]的原因，也是我学习的原因。

lines.en: : Or...try to learn.
lines.zh: : 或者……试着学习。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is time for you to grow up as well, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 也许你也该长大了，Sensei。

lines.en: : When did you get so mature?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候变得这么成熟了？

lines.en: : Go back to talking about noodles and cracking stand-up jokes.
lines.zh: : 回去聊你的面条、讲你的脱口秀笑话吧。

lines.en: scene blackout11
: Do not provide me false hope.
lines.zh: : 别给我虚假的希望。

lines.en: : We both know that I am unfit for comedy.
lines.zh: : 我们都清楚，我不是搞喜剧的料。

lines.en: : You’re unfit for most things, to be completely fair.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你大多事情都不合适。

lines.en: scene blackout10
: It’s true.
lines.zh: : 是真的。

lines.en: : I will die here the same way my father will.
lines.zh: : 我会和我父亲一样，死在这里。

lines.en: : The only difference is that there will be no one to make sense of the borderline inaudible noises I make as I dissolve into the ground.
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是，当我化作泥土时，没有人能听懂我发出的那些几乎听不见的声音。

lines.en: scene black
I instinctively jump back in my seat after a loud bang shakes the restaurant.
lines.zh: 一声巨响震动了整间餐馆，我本能地从座位上跳了起来。

lines.en: I have no idea what it was, but it appears to have cut the power as well.
lines.zh: 我不知道那是什么，但看起来电也被切断了。

lines.en: : Oh dear.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : “Oh dear?”
: That’s all?
lines.zh: : 就这？

lines.en: : Are you not scared right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在不害怕吗？

lines.en: : Why would I fear the darkness? I do not have darknessophobia.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要怕黑？我又没有黑暗恐惧症。

lines.en: : I just thought your reaction would be a bit stronger than “Oh dear.”
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你的反应该比「哎呀」强烈一点。

lines.en: : This is not the first time this has happened.
lines.zh: : 这种事不是第一次发生了。

lines.en: : The machines keeping my father well require a large amount of energy.
lines.zh: : 维持我父亲健康的机器需要大量电力。

lines.en: : Sometimes, the power goes off as a result of that.
lines.zh: : 有时候电就会因此断掉。

lines.en: : Do you have a generator or...a backup power source or anything?
lines.zh: : 你们有发电机什么的……或者备用电源吗？

lines.en: : We do. It should turn on down here momentarily.
lines.zh: : 有。楼下这个应该马上就会启动。

lines.en: : In the meantime, please excuse me while I go check on my father.
lines.zh: : 在此期间，失陪一下，我去看看我父亲。

lines.en: : He will likely die if the backup power has not yet turned on upstairs either.
lines.zh: : 如果楼上的备用电源也还没启动，他大概会死。

lines.en: : Do you want me to co-
lines.zh: : 要我一起——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不用。

lines.en: : You must stay down here.
lines.zh: : 你必须待在楼下。

lines.en: : He’s very adamant about remaining unseen.
lines.zh: : 他非常坚持不愿被人看见。

lines.en: : Please continue to enjoy your noodle-less curry, though.
lines.zh: : 不过请继续享用你那份没有面的咖喱。

lines.en: I hear Tsuneyo get off of the stool next to me and make her way over to the door.
lines.zh: 我听见 Tsuneyo 从旁边的凳子上下来，朝门口走去。

lines.en: I’d have probably felt a little better if I was able to go with her but, then again, I’m not sure I’d enjoy seeing her half-dead father.
lines.zh: 如果能跟她一起去，我大概会好受些，不过话说回来，我也不确定自己会想看她那半死的父亲。

lines.en: I’m just hoping the lights-
lines.zh: 我只希望灯——

lines.en: scene blackout12
The backup power source comes on and everything turns red.
lines.zh: 备用电源启动了，一切都变成了红色。

lines.en: Well, mostly everything.
lines.zh: 嗯，几乎是一切。

lines.en: My curry is still a mixture of brown and white.
lines.zh: 我的咖喱依然是棕色和白色的混合物。

lines.en: Coincidentally, those are also the colors of Tsuneyo and me.
lines.zh: 巧了，那也是 Tsuneyo 和我的颜色。

lines.en: And when placed together on the same plate or, in this very specific circumstance, a restaurant-slash-confessional, things seem to work out pretty well!
lines.zh: 当它们被放在同一个盘子里——或者在这个非常特定的场合，一家餐馆兼告解室里——事情似乎进展得相当顺利！

lines.en: I insert my spoon into Tsuneyo and me and shovel the two of us into my mouth.
lines.zh: 我把勺子插进 Tsuneyo 和我，然后把我们俩铲进嘴里。

lines.en: We taste delicious.
lines.zh: 我们尝起来美味极了。

lines.en: I spit out my food just so I can eat it again.
lines.zh: 我把食物吐出来，就为了能再吃一次。

lines.en: They should turn the lights off in here more often.
lines.zh: 他们该更经常地把这里的灯关掉。

lines.en: Maybe then I’d feel comfortable enough to admit that Yumi is only scared of me because I came within two steps of [raping] her in broad daylight.
lines.zh: 也许那样我才会自在到愿意承认：Yumi 怕我，只是因为我曾在光天化日之下差点[raping]了她。

lines.en: Does a beautiful sunset count as broad daylight?
lines.zh: 美丽的夕阳算光天化日吗？

lines.en: Or is it vague daylight or something else comparable at that point?
lines.zh: 还是说到了那个点，只能算「模糊的日光」什么的？

lines.en: I spit my food out a third time before the consistency becomes too gooey to enjoy anymore.
lines.zh: 在口感变得太糊、没法再享用之前，我第三次把食物吐了出来。

lines.en: I begrudgingly swallow it in the same fashion that delinquent begrudgingly swallowed my saliva all those {s}days? weeks? years?{/s} ?????? ago.
lines.zh: 我极不情愿地把它咽下去，就像那个不良少女在那么多 ?????? 之前极不情愿地咽下我的唾液一样。

lines.en: Where it happened wasn’t far from here.
lines.zh: 那件事发生的地方离这儿不远。

lines.en: Tsuneyo was right when she mentioned how this part of town is mostly dying.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 说这一带基本在死去，她说得对。

lines.en: I wonder if there’s a blackout in the surrounding buildings as well.
lines.zh: 我想知道周围的楼是不是也停电了。

lines.en: I could get away with so many things if I wasn’t so busy consuming myself.
lines.zh: 如果不是忙着吞食自己，我本可以干成很多事。

lines.en: The footsteps leak back into my head but I’m unable to see where they’re coming from.
lines.zh: 脚步声又渗回我的脑袋，可我看不见它们是从哪儿来的。

lines.en: It’s almost like ghosts threw some shoes on and started pacing around the place-
lines.zh: 简直像是幽灵们套上鞋，开始在这地方来回踱步——

lines.en: Hoping to score one last sip of broth before returning to Heaven or Hell or whichever other make-believe afterlife they were fortunate or unfortunate enough to find an apartment in.
lines.zh: 盼望在回到天堂或地狱、或随便哪个他们有幸或不幸地在里面找到公寓的虚构来世之前，再讨到最后一口汤。

lines.en: scene blackout12
I feel...strange.
lines.zh: 我感觉……怪怪的。

lines.en: Kind of like I’m losing track of time.
lines.zh: 有点像我正在失去时间感。

lines.en: How long has the power been off?
lines.zh: 电断了多久了？

lines.en: Tsuneyo hasn’t come back downstairs yet, has she?
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 还没下楼来，是吗？

lines.en: I slide my phone out of my pocket to check the time.
lines.zh: 我把手机从口袋里掏出来看时间。

lines.en: And, of course, it appears to be dead.
lines.zh: 然后，它理所当然地没电了。

lines.en: Just my luck.
lines.zh: 我这运气。

lines.en: I could have sworn it was on nearly full battery before coming here, but it wouldn’t be the first time I’ve been wrong about that.
lines.zh: 我明明记得来之前它差不多是满电的，不过这种事我记错也不是第一次了。

lines.en: Part of me wants to just get up and leave since it’s starting to get extremely cold, but-
lines.zh: 一方面，天越来越冷，我只想起身走人，可是——

lines.en: Not only would I feel bad for abandoning Tsuneyo before even paying for dinner-
lines.zh: 且不说说我连饭钱都没付就丢下 Tsuneyo 会让我心里过意不去——

lines.en: I kind of...
lines.zh: 我有点……

lines.en: Can’t get out of my chair.
lines.zh: 从椅子上起不来。

lines.en: I mean, maybe I can, but-
lines.zh: 我是说，也许我起得来，可是——

lines.en: I don’t want to.
lines.zh: 我不想起来。

lines.en: I’ve become content in my spot at the counter.
lines.zh: 我已经在柜台前这个位置上自在了起来。

lines.en: Tojo Ramen really is a special place.
lines.zh: Tojo Ramen 真是个特别的地方。

lines.en: I haven’t felt this at-home in quite some time.
lines.zh: 我已经很久没有过这种「在家」的感觉了。

lines.en: scene blackout13
: Oh. You’re still here.
lines.zh: : 哦。你还在啊。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？

lines.en: scene blackout14
: Ah-
: How long were you gone for?
lines.zh: : 你去了多久？

lines.en: scene blackout15
: Half an hour.
lines.zh: : 半小时。

lines.en: : I assumed you just went home.
lines.zh: : 我以为你已经回家了。

lines.en: Has it really been that long?
lines.zh: 真的过了那么久吗？

lines.en: I feel like the power’s only been off for a few minutes.
lines.zh: 我感觉电才断了没几分钟。

lines.en: : Is your dad okay?
lines.zh: : 你父亲还好吗？

lines.en: : He’s fine.
lines.zh: : 他没事。

lines.en: : The backup power upstairs starts immediately in the event of an outage.
lines.zh: : 停电的时候，楼上的备用电源会立刻启动。

lines.en: : The reason it takes so long to reach the ground floor is that my father requires almost all of it.
lines.zh: : 之所以要那么久才轮到一楼，是因为我父亲几乎用掉了全部的电。

lines.en: : Electricity can be very lazy.
lines.zh: : 电是很懒的。

lines.en: : Do you know when the power will be coming back on?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么时候会来电吗？

lines.en: : That depends on {i}how{/i} lazy the electricity wants to be.
lines.zh: : 那要看电想偷{i}多懒{/i}。

lines.en: : There are many wires, so I assume it will take quite some time to catch up.
lines.zh: : 线路很多，所以我估计得花不少时间才能补上来。

lines.en: : Do you want a box for your curry?
lines.zh: : 你的咖喱要打包盒吗？

lines.en: : I see that you haven't even touched it since I left.
lines.zh: : 我看我走之后你一口都没动过。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. I-
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。我——

lines.en: I look down at the plate of curry to find that...
lines.zh: 我低头看向那盘咖喱，发现……

lines.en: I must have inadvertently...drawn a smile in the sauce?
lines.zh: 我一定是不小心……在酱汁里画了一个笑脸？

lines.en: : Hey, you didn’t...play with my food while the lights were off, did you?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你没在灯灭的时候……玩我的食物吧？

lines.en: : Food is for eating, not playing.
lines.zh: : 食物是用来吃的，不是用来玩的。

lines.en: : If you want to play with food, choose a different restaurant. You are not welcome here.
lines.zh: : 如果你想玩食物，请换一家店。这里不欢迎你。

lines.en: : Just...get me a box. I don’t want to play with my food.
lines.zh: : 就……给我个盒子吧。我不想玩我的食物。

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : The food is on the house today as apologies for the inconvenience and loss of power.
lines.zh: : 今天的餐费免单，算是为断电给您带来的不便致歉。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. Thanks a lot. You didn’t have to do that.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。非常感谢。你不必这样的。

lines.en: : It was my father’s idea.
lines.zh: : 这是我父亲的主意。

lines.en: : He could sense that there was a guest downstairs.
lines.zh: : 他感觉得到楼下有客人。

lines.en: : I personally think we should have charged you for insulting us by ordering that stupid dish.
lines.zh: : 我个人认为，你点了那道蠢菜侮辱我们，我们该收你钱才对。

lines.en: : You really don’t like curry, do you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的不喜欢咖喱，对吧？

lines.en: : I love it.
lines.zh: : 我爱死它了。

lines.en: : Please never order it again.
lines.zh: : 请永远别再点了。

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo grabs me a box near the register and I shovel the rest of my dinner inside, placing it in a bag she lays out next to me as I do so.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 从收银台旁给我拿了个盒子，我把剩下的晚餐铲进去，放进她摆在我旁边的袋子里。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen sincerely apologizes for the loss of power during your visit tonight.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 为今晚您光临时断电深表歉意。

lines.en: : Please accept this coupon for 23%% off of your next check.
lines.zh: : 请收下这张优惠券，下次结账可减 23%。

lines.en: : Why not just round up to 25%%?
lines.zh: : 为什么不干脆凑个整，减 25%？

lines.en: : I don’t make the rules, just the noodles.
lines.zh: : 规矩不是我定的，我只做面条。

lines.en: : Well...thanks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢了，大概吧。

lines.en: : No, thank you.
lines.zh: : 不，该说谢谢的是我。

lines.en: : Please come back soon.
lines.zh: : 请尽快再来。

lines.en: : We are grateful as always for your business.
lines.zh: : 一如既往感谢您的惠顾。

lines.en: I tie the handles of the plastic bag into a knot and exit the store.
lines.zh: 我把塑料袋的提手打了个结，走出店门。

lines.en: It’s snowing out.
lines.zh: 外面在下雪。

lines.en: I wind up throwing away my curry in the first garbage bin I find.
lines.zh: 我最后把咖喱扔进了遇到的第一个垃圾桶。

lines.en: I don’t know why.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么。
